methodology.pressure_definition: an off-ball defender counts as pressuring the ball carrier when within 5.0m AND at least one of: touch-tight (<1.5m), closing speed >= 2.5 m/s over roughly 0.5s, or stepped out >= 4.0m ahead of their team's own out-of-possession baseline defensive line. Raw proximity alone is NOT treated as pressure -- this is meant to exclude a passive deep block that the attacker simply walked into.
methodology.possession_segmentation: possession events are segmented from carrier_track_id transitions with keep-last gap fill; a no-carrier gap >= 30.0s is treated as a stoppage rather than a possession change.
methodology.ppda_convention: PPDA zone is classified relative to the DEFENDING team's own third, not the attacking team's.
methodology.defensive_line_convention: defensive line height = average distance from own goal of the last-3 defenders, computed only on out-of-possession frames.
methodology.team_shape_convention: depth = distance between the back-3 and front-3 outfield players along the team's own attack direction; width = IQR-trimmed lateral spread (multiplier 1.5); both restricted to out-of-possession frames.
methodology.stoppage_handling: >= 30.0s continuous no-carrier gaps are excluded from live-play stats as stoppages (injury, goal, VAR check, cooling break, etc.).
methodology.event_count_note: counts named 'n_events' or similar mean different things in different tables and will not match each other: regain_summary counts individual pressure EVENTS (a team can have several per possession, or one spanning a possession boundary), while final_pressure_by_team's n_events counts POSSESSION events instead. A 144-vs-101 style mismatch between these is expected, not a data error.
methodology.zone_outcome_summary_convention: zone_outcome_summary's 'zone' column is relative to the team the row's actions belong to (the team being pressured), not the pressing team -- e.g. team=1's own_third row is about team 1's actions in team 1's own third, and credit for any disruption/turnover there belongs to team 0's press. pressing_profile's turnover_rate_<zone> columns are already re-oriented to the PRESSING team's own zone labels, so the two tables use zone labels from opposite perspectives by design.
methodology.pass_summary_vs_outcome_pct_scope: pass_summary's success_rate is completed/attempted PASSES only. outcome_pct covers a broader event set (passes + tackles + long-ball-gap events) split into finer outcome categories (progressed/forced-sideways/forced-backward/lost-intercepted/etc). The two tables have different denominators and category schemes by design -- e.g. pass_summary success % and (100 - outcome_pct's lost-category %) will not reconcile, and that is expected, not an error.
methodology.lane_blocking_only_pressure_events: a team-frame is flagged is_pressing if n_pressing >= 2 OR frac_tight_blocked >= 0.375 (passing-lane blocking alone can qualify, without any proximity presser meeting the closing-speed/touch-tight/step-out gate from the pressure_definition above). A pressure event can therefore legitimately show mean_n_pressing and max_n_pressing near zero throughout if it was driven entirely by lane-blocking rather than proximity pressure -- check mean_frac_tight_blocked on that event before treating a low-n_pressing event as a data error.
methodology.shape_by_pressure_state_orientation: shape_by_pressure_state's under_team_pressure column (legacy export name of the internal is_pressing flag) reads as 'this team is being pressed' but means the OPPOSITE: the team in that row (the pressing side) is the team APPLYING pressure, so a True row is this team's own shape WHILE THEY ARE PRESSING, not their shape while under the opponent's press. Confirmed by frame counts: the True rows match each team's own zone_pressure_counts totals exactly.
methodology.disruption_rate_pct_orientation: disruption_rate_pct uses the SAME orientation as zone_outcome_summary -- team = the team whose action was disrupted, credit for the disruption belongs to the OPPONENT's press (see zone_outcome_summary_convention above). It is computed once, directly, from unrounded event-level outcomes -- reconstructing it by averaging zone_outcome_summary's already-1-decimal-rounded per-zone rates will drift by a few tenths of a point from double-rounding; that drift is expected numerical noise, not an orientation error.
methodology.metric_naming_convention: is_pressing = the team is applying pressure (credit: pressing team); under_pressure = the team WITH the ball was being pressed (credit: the opponent's press). Every metric in metric_catalogue states which team it describes in its 'credit' field. headline_metrics (team section) lists one value per team for every catalogue metric.
methodology.out_of_possession_denominator: press_time_pct and zone_weighted_press_pct divide pressing seconds by the team's out-of-possession seconds counted only on frames where a ball carrier is identified, because pressing can only be detected on those frames. Share-of-time pressing metrics therefore describe identified-carrier play only.
methodology.possession_convention: possession_pct_carrier = share of live frames with an identified ball carrier in which the team has the ball; possession_pct_labelled uses every live frame with a possession label (gaps filled with the last known team). possession_by_zone_pct is relative to the team's own attacking direction. Stoppages are excluded from all possession figures.

data_quality.carrier_coverage_note: the ball carrier is only identified for this share of frames; frames without a carrier are excluded from carrier-dependent metrics (pressure, passes, PPDA), which slightly undercounts fast or contested play.
data_quality.identity_fragmentation_note: player identities are tracked, not fully re-identified across the whole match, so this count is higher than the true number of players (camera-angle / occlusion fragmentation). Player-level stats should be read as per-track-segment, not fully resolved per-athlete; team-level aggregates are not affected by this.

metric_catalogue.label: Share of opponent possession under pressure
metric_catalogue.definition: Per possession event: share of frames with the opponent pressing; averaged per pressing team, weighted by possession duration.
metric_catalogue.denominator: frames with an identified carrier, inside the opponent's possession events (stoppages excluded)

metric_catalogue.label: PPDA
metric_catalogue.definition: Opponent completed passes outside the defending team's own third / own defensive actions (interceptions, tackles) outside that third.
metric_catalogue.denominator: defensive actions in the same zones

metric_catalogue.label: Press -> regain rate
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of pressure events after which the pressing team had the ball within 5s of the event ending.
metric_catalogue.denominator: pressure events

metric_catalogue.label: Share of opponent's pressured actions disrupted
metric_catalogue.definition: Opponent actions made under pressure that were forced sideways/backward, intercepted, tackled or lost on a long ball.
metric_catalogue.denominator: opponent actions made under pressure (passes, tackles, long-gap transitions)

metric_catalogue.label: Turnover rate forced, own third
metric_catalogue.definition: Opponent pressured actions in the pressing team's OWN third that ended in a lost ball.
metric_catalogue.denominator: opponent pressured actions in that zone

metric_catalogue.label: Turnover rate forced, middle third
metric_catalogue.definition: Opponent pressured actions in the middle third that ended in a lost ball.
metric_catalogue.denominator: opponent pressured actions in that zone

metric_catalogue.label: Turnover rate forced, attacking third
metric_catalogue.definition: Opponent pressured actions in the pressing team's ATTACKING third that ended in a lost ball.
metric_catalogue.denominator: opponent pressured actions in that zone

metric_catalogue.label: Regain rate after a fast counter-press
metric_catalogue.definition: After losing the ball, share of turnovers where the team pressed within 5s and had the ball back within 5s of the opponent's takeover.
metric_catalogue.denominator: turnovers where the team pressed within the window

metric_catalogue.label: Pressing time as share of out-of-possession time
metric_catalogue.definition: Seconds with is_pressing / live out-of-possession seconds.
metric_catalogue.denominator: live out-of-possession seconds on frames with an identified ball carrier (stoppages excluded)

metric_catalogue.label: Zone-weighted pressing intensity
metric_catalogue.definition: Pressing frames weighted own third x1, middle x2, attacking x3, over the maximum possible (all out-of-possession frames pressing in the attacking third).
metric_catalogue.denominator: 3 x out-of-possession seconds on frames with an identified ball carrier

metric_catalogue.label: Coordinated presses
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of pressure events with at least two defenders pressing at once.
metric_catalogue.denominator: pressure events

metric_catalogue.label: Median time to press after losing the ball
metric_catalogue.definition: Median seconds from losing the ball to the first is_pressing frame, searched up to 10s.
metric_catalogue.denominator: turnovers where a press was detected

metric_catalogue.label: Press follows an opponent reception
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of opponent pass receptions followed by pressing within 2s.
metric_catalogue.denominator: opponent completed-pass receptions

metric_catalogue.label: Defensive line height
metric_catalogue.definition: Mean distance from own goal of the last 3 defenders, all frames, outliers removed.
metric_catalogue.denominator: frames

metric_catalogue.label: Block area while pressing
metric_catalogue.definition: Depth x width of the outfield block on frames where the team is pressing.
metric_catalogue.denominator: out-of-possession frames while pressing

metric_catalogue.label: Block area while not pressing
metric_catalogue.definition: Depth x width of the outfield block on out-of-possession frames while not pressing.
metric_catalogue.denominator: out-of-possession frames not pressing

metric_catalogue.label: Own passes made under pressure
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of the team's own passes released after sustained opponent pressing (>= 8 consecutive frames in the last 1s).
metric_catalogue.denominator: the team's own pass attempts

metric_catalogue.label: Pass completion under pressure
metric_catalogue.definition: Completed / attempted passes released under pressure.
metric_catalogue.denominator: the team's own passes under pressure

metric_catalogue.label: Possession share (carrier identified)
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of live frames with an identified ball carrier in which the team has the ball.
metric_catalogue.denominator: live frames with an identified carrier (stoppages excluded)

metric_catalogue.label: Mean possession spell length
metric_catalogue.definition: Mean duration of the team's possession events (4.2).
metric_catalogue.denominator: the team's possession events

metric_catalogue.higher_means: more possession high up the pitch
metric_catalogue.label: Possession in the attacking third
metric_catalogue.definition: Share of the team's possession frames with the ball in the team's attacking third.
metric_catalogue.denominator: the team's possession frames with a known ball position
